properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The SHA-1 is used in RFC 4122/9562 UUID v5 generation for stable deterministic IDs, not as a cryptographic integrity primitive. The comment explicitly states this is for "stable deterministic IDs, not as a cryptographic integrity primitive."

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The project uses @noble/curves library for cryptographic operations, specifically for signature verification. secp256k1 is a quantum-vulnerable elliptic curve that should be migrated to ML-DSA-65.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The code compares MAC or digest values using '==' operator instead of constant-time comparison, which can leak timing information and potentially be exploited for attacks.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: NIST P-256 curve (ECDH-P256) is used in test files for signing operations. While this is used in tests, it represents a quantum-vulnerable cryptographic primitive that could be broken by Shor's algorithm.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The project uses @noble/curves library for cryptographic operations including Ed25519 signatures. Ed25519 is a quantum-vulnerable signature algorithm that needs migration to ML-DSA-65.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The project uses @noble/curves library for cryptographic operations including P-256 (secp256r1) signatures. P-256 is a quantum-vulnerable elliptic curve that needs migration to ML-DSA-65.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The project uses @noble/hashes library for cryptographic operations including SHA-256. SHA-256 is quantum-safe for hashing but is used in digital signatures and certificate generation which may involve vulnerable curves.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The project uses @noble/hashes library for cryptographic operations including BLAKE3. BLAKE3 is quantum-safe for hashing and doesn't pose a quantum threat.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The project uses @noble/hashes library for cryptographic operations including SHA-3. SHA-3 is quantum-safe for hashing and doesn't pose a quantum threat.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The project uses @noble/ciphers library for cryptographic operations including AES-GCM. AES-GCM is quantum-safe for encryption but is part of a system where quantum-vulnerable key exchanges may be used.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The project uses @noble/ciphers library for cryptographic operations including ChaCha20-Poly1305. ChaCha20-Poly1305 is quantum-safe for encryption but is part of a system where quantum-vulnerable key exchanges may be used.
